mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shipments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM shipments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE shipments SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirm_source = #{source}, confirmed_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{shipmentId} AND status = 'SHIPPED'
mapper.sql: shipment.status = 'SHIPPED' AND shipment.carrier_signed_at IS NOT NULL AND shipment.auto_confirm_at <= #{now} AND shipment.allocation_state='COMPLETE' AND order_head.fulfillment_state='READY' AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity),0) FROM shipment_items si WHERE si.shipment_id=shipment.id) > (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ai.quantity),0) FROM after_sale_items ai JOIN after_sale_cases sale ON sale.id=ai.case_id AND sale.status='REFUNDED' WHERE ai.source_shipment_id=shipment.id)
mapper.select: SELECT shipment.id FROM shipments shipment JOIN orders order_head ON order_head.id = shipment.order_id WHERE ORDER BY shipment.auto_confirm_at, shipment.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, shipment.auto_confirm_at, #{now}) FROM shipments shipment JOIN orders order_head ON order_head.id = shipment.order_id WHERE ORDER BY shipment.auto_confirm_at, shipment.id LIMIT 1
